data.body_html:
Pride 2049 in Marbella is set to be the biggest celebration yet, and there is no better way to experience it than from the deck of a private yacht. A Marbella boat rental Pride 2049 Puerto Banús gives you front-row seats to the energy, the sun, and the sea — with your own skipper, drinks, and snacks included. Whether you want to cruise the Golden Mile, anchor at Cala del Faro, or simply party in the bay, our fleet of 17 boats (from €749 for 2 hours) makes it easy. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's luxury marina.

Why choose a Marbella boat rental for Pride 2049?

Pride 2049 in Marbella is about freedom, colour, and joy. A private boat rental amplifies that experience. You control the music, the company, and the itinerary — no queues, no crowds, just you and your guests on the Mediterranean. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). That means zero hidden costs. You can bring your own Pride flags, decorations, and even a Bluetooth speaker. For larger groups, we can arrange a DJ or custom catering on request.

Your skipper knows the coast intimately. Popular Pride itineraries include: cruising past the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina, anchoring at Cala del Faro for a swim, heading to Cabopino for a beach stop, or sailing towards Estepona for a longer adventure. For sunset lovers, a late-afternoon charter offers golden light over La Concha mountain. You can also stay in Puerto Banús bay and watch the Pride festivities from the water.

What to bring for your Pride 2049 boat party

We recommend swimwear, sunscreen (SPF 50+), a towel, sunglasses, and a hat. Bring your own Pride flags, banners, and decorations. A Bluetooth speaker is fine — most boats have an AUX or Bluetooth system. If you want a DJ, let us know in advance. For food, you can bring your own or order a catering package (sushi, paella, tapas — available on request). All drinks are included, but you are welcome to bring your own if you prefer something specific.

How to book your Marbella boat rental for Pride 2049

Pride 2049 is expected to be the busiest weekend of the summer. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability, pricing, and to secure your slot with a deposit. We will confirm your boat, skipper, and itinerary. For groups of 10 or more, consider the Mangusta 80 (12 pax, jet ski included) or the Ferretti 94 (12 pax, 29m of luxury).
